title: Alcatel USB Desk
subtitle: Your Android screen and camera, over USB.
ready: Connect your phone, unlock it and authorize USB debugging. Then refresh devices.
keyboardHelp: First open the phone. In Android physical keyboard settings, select scrcpy and enable Russian and English (US). Switch with Ctrl+Space in the phone window. Windows language switching does not change the Android layout. Alt+K opens these settings. Spanish is optional; remove it in the same Android layout list.
cameraHelp: Camera mode captures the stock camera preview, not a raw webcam. The crop is preset for the Alcatel 5024D. If the camera goes idle, wake its preview on the phone. Use OBS Virtual Camera for video calls.
scrollHelp: In the active phone window, point at the screen and use the wheel to scroll up or down. Drag with the left mouse button to move left or right.
started: Session started. Startup errors and disconnect details appear in logs.
ended: Session ended. Check logs if it closed unexpectedly.
keyboardReady: On the phone: scrcpy > Set up keyboard layouts > Russian + English (US).
setup: Run Setup.cmd first to install scrcpy and ADB.
cameraSummary: Stock camera preview. Rotation and crop are applied when you start the camera.
waitForOperation: Wait for the current operation to finish, then close the window.
